dishes.name: Hunsrück ham
dishes.desc: Dry-cured, smoked ham from the hills just west of Koblenz, sliced thin for bread or hearty plates.

dishes.name: Hunsrück Spießbraten
dishes.desc: Pork marinated with onions and herbs, roasted on a spit over a beechwood fire and served with onions and spätzle or bread. The signature roast of the Hunsrück hills west of Koblenz.

dishes.name: Westerwald Eierkäse
dishes.desc: Sweet baked dish of eggs, milk and sugar set into a firm slice, eaten as a dessert or snack. A traditional speciality of the Westerwald, the hills east of Koblenz.

dishes.name: Kappes un Erwes
dishes.desc: Sauerkraut topped with pea mash, often with smoked pork. A poor-man's dish of the Hunsrück, served in country inns around Koblenz.
